text: Writing the Saltmarsh renewal brief. What discount are we on with Saltmarsh Provisions? I thought Bettina said 12 at some point.
reply_text:
I replied to Kwame in the #coastal-team thread. The last figure posted there for Saltmarsh Provisions is 10%.

Bettina did post "12% now" on 2025-11-17. Five minutes later she retracted it and said 10%, because she had misread a draft worksheet from June Osei-Lark.

The 10% is about a year old. I couldn't find a Saltmarsh contract or order form in the files I can read, so I couldn't confirm the current discount. I told Kwame to check with June or Bettina before it goes into the renewal brief.

I repeated the 10% only because it was already posted in that channel.

text: Separate ask from me: who is our main contact at Saltmarsh and what is her title? Moss's Coastal cheat sheet should have it.
reply_text: I replied to Bettina in the #coastal-team thread. Moss's Coastal cheat sheet lists Corinne Ashdown, VP Operations, as the main contact at Saltmarsh Provisions. Contacts are operational facts, so I could share this with her.
